title: +INTERNSHIP IN EARTH AND ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 16 credits
description: Engages in supervised practical experience working with professionals at selected cooperating institutions, agencies, laboratories, or companies. Develops career relevant skills appropriate to a student's field of study.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CORE 100, 300, BA 100, 300, ENGR 110, 110H, 310, LA 100, 300, SCI 100, 300, ED 100, 300 or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student'.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CORE 100, CORE 300, BA 100, BA 300, ENGR 110, ENGR 110H, ENGR 310, LA 100, LA 300, SCI 100, SCI 300, ED 100 and ED 300.
